description: Evidence-first family memory canvas built on WebMCP. Agents must cite sources, surface uncertainty, and may never resolve a contradiction on their own.

language_policy.note: Vietnamese in seed data and demo copy is intentional — the story is Vietnamese.

frozen_files.why: data contract shared by all three branches
frozen_files.change_process: open a task, notify the team, update docs/API_SCHEMA.md in the same PR

frozen_files.why: tool contract exposed to the agent
frozen_files.change_process: open a task, notify the team, update docs/API_SCHEMA.md in the same PR

invariants.rule: Humans and agents share one write door: commands.ts
Only the command layer touches the database
The registry is a pure function tools = f(uiState)

invariants.check: no domain state in useState/useRef under src/view, src/panels

core_constraints: claim_confirmed_needs_a_human — certainty='confirmed' requires confirmed_by and confirmed_at
claim_evidence_backed — document_supported requires evidence with stance='supports'
conflict_resolution_needs_a_human — resolving a conflict requires a named person

ownership.risk: WebGL may not survive the ChatGPT in-app browser
the WebMCP API name is not settled yet
bilingual content takes longer than expected

never: add a backend, API route, or any runtime network call
let an agent set certainty='confirmed' without confirmed_by
drop or weaken the three core constraints in schema.sql
commit node_modules, secrets, or real family data

claude_code_automations.note: Claude-Code-specific mechanisms — not shimmable to Codex/Cursor/Copilot the way .agent/ is, since their physical location is their registration with the harness. Documented here so this map stays complete; the RULE TEXT they check against still lives only in .agent/ and docs/ — these files point to it rather than restate it.

servers.playwright: real-browser automation — replaces ad hoc Puppeteer scratch scripts
servers.context7: live docs for fast-moving deps: PGlite, WebMCP draft, r3f/drei

subagents.invariant-guardian.md: manual R1-R5 pass; points at .agent/rules/invariants.md for the rule text
subagents.trust-boundary-reviewer.md: hunts the resolveClaim bug class; points at .agent/rules/invariants.md + docs/requirements/non-functional/NFR-TRUST-epistemic-integrity.md

skills.gen-test/SKILL.md: generates Vitest tests against real PGlite for the untested write door (commands.ts, audit.ts, db.ts, modelContext.ts)

hooks.PostToolUse: typecheck (blocking) + arch:check (advisory) on Edit/Write under src/
